# NovaPanel v1.6.142

- Fleet configuration templates now let you select the exact inbounds to copy; only those inbounds are added or updated, and referenced TLS certificates are included automatically.
- Rollout previews list inbound tags that will be added or updated. New target inbounds now generate their local client configuration correctly, including MASQUE's target-specific ECDSA identity.
- Aggregate Clash subscriptions keep distinct nodes that share an inbound name by assigning unique proxy names, while still removing exact duplicate nodes.
